page_title: ALA 1-1 BET | Alaves v Betis 08/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Willian Jose (Betis) receives a red card after his horrific challenge and is sent off!
90+3' Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
90+2' Ander Guevara (Alaves) commits a foul and Alejandro Hernandez immediately signals a free kick.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Isco (Betis) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
89' Ayoze Perez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Aitor Ruibal (Betis).
86' Luis Garcia Plaza is forced to make a change. Javi Lopez is unable to continue due to injury, Ruben Duarte (Alaves) comes on.
86' Substitution. Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) in, Luis Rioja out.
84' Javi Lopez (Alaves) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
83' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Samu (Alaves) for his blatant foul.
82' Samu (Alaves) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
81' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
79' Isco (Betis) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
77' Substitution. Samu (Alaves) replaces Kike Garcia.
76' The referee allows time for a substitution. Marc Roca will be replaced by Andres Guardado (Betis).
76' Substitution. Willian Jose (Betis) has come on for Assane Diao.
73' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to make a change. Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) replaces Ianis Hagi.
73' Here comes a substitution. Alex Sola is given a rest as he is replaced by Xeber Alkain (Alaves).
72' Alex Sola (Alaves) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Claudio Bravo.
71' Yellow card. Abner (Betis) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
67' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle and it's Ayoze Perez (Betis) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
65' Here comes a substitution. Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) is brought on as a substitute for Rodri.
63' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 35:65.
62' Luis Rioja (Alaves) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
60' Chadi Riad (Betis) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
58' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
58' Hector Bellerin (Betis) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Betis earn a corner.
56' Rodri (Betis) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
52' Kike Garcia (Alaves) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes well past the right post.
51' The Betis players are exchanging some short passes.
48' Alex Sola (Alaves) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
46' Half-time substitution. Manuel Pellegrini decided to make a change. Guido Rodriguez (Betis) is replaced by William Carvalho.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Hector Bellerin (Betis) is penalised for a foul. Alejandro Hernandez had a clear view and blows his whistle.
45+3' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
45+3' Javi Lopez (Alaves) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
45+1' Golden opportunity! Marc Roca (Betis) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' Alaves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
44' A snap shot by Kike Garcia (Alaves) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Claudio Bravo produces a good save to thwart him. Alaves get a corner.
43' Alaves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
43' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Alex Sola (Alaves). The ball goes out for a corner. Alaves can continue in their attacking effort.
42' The corner is swung in but Betis can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
42' Rodri (Betis) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Betis.
41' Referee Alejandro Hernandez signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Alaves players have a reason to celebrate!
38' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Alaves players aren’t happy.
35' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Hector Bellerin (Betis) is the one who put the ball into his own net.
34' Guido Rodriguez (Betis) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.
32' 0 - 1 Goal 0:1! Ayoze Perez (Betis) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.

27' Luis Rioja (Alaves) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the left post. Claudio Bravo has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
24' OFF THE POST! Rodri (Betis) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot which smashes against the right post.
24' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing.

24' Isco (Betis) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
22' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 4:0.
19' Kike Garcia (Alaves) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar.
18' Kike Garcia (Alaves) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
15' Luis Rioja (Alaves) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Claudio Bravo makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
11' The Betis players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
8' Flag up against Ayoze Perez (Betis). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
5' Alaves quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

4' Kike Garcia (Alaves) found himself in a promising position. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made a decent save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Alaves are going to take it.
4' Alaves take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

4' A lofted cross from Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play. Alaves will have a chance to score from a corner.
3' Isco (Betis) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
1' The first half has just begun.
Betis will kick-off.
Alejandro Hernandez will officiate today.
